biggest_catch: Your friend has to do real banking within 60 days: make ten or more debit/credit card transactions AND receive one electronic deposit of $250+ (ACH, mobile deposit, or Zelle). A friend who opens the account but never uses it earns you nothing.
catches: Friend must register, open a new Velocity Credit Union checking account, and within 60 days: complete ten (10) or more debit and/or credit card transactions (excluding ATM transactions), AND complete one (1) electronic deposit of $250 or more via ACH, mobile deposits, or Zelle deposits.
Both the referrer and the friend receive a $50 Mastercard Virtual Reward once all qualifications are completed ('you and the person who referred you will BOTH receive a Mastercard Virtual Reward!').
Allow 2-3 weeks for delivery of the Virtual Reward after completing all offer requirements.
No stated referral cap and no stated expiration on the fetched page.
No 1099/tax disclosure on the fetched page.

steps: Share your Velocity CU referral with a friend.
Your friend registers on the referral page and opens a new Velocity Credit Union checking account.
Within 60 days, your friend completes 10+ debit/credit card transactions (excl. ATM) and one electronic deposit of $250+ (ACH, mobile, or Zelle).
After all qualifications are completed, you and your friend each receive a $50 Mastercard Virtual Reward within 2-3 weeks.
